maintenance_led.reason: Mostly new sales of analytical instruments, test equipment and electromechanical devices/components, not aftermarket repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private industrial, medical, energy and aerospace manufacturers; defense is only a part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Strategic acquisitions are one of its four growth strategies; it buys niche instrument and device businesses regularly.

mission_critical.reason: Engineered instruments and components are qualified into customers' aerospace, medical and power products; switching needs re-qualification.
